skills.description: Search and analyze bidding/tender information across Chinese government procurement and third-party bidding platforms. This skill should be used when the user wants to: search for bidding announcements on a specific topic or industry, analyze bid winning patterns (winning companies, winning prices, market trends), evaluate business opportunities in public procurement, or monitor competitors bidding activities. Triggers include: search bids, find tenders, analyze bidding, find procurement opportunities, who won the bid, bid analysis, find business opportunities, tender search, or any request involving 招标, 中标, 竞标, 采购, 投标 in Chinese.
skills.description_zh:
本技能帮助用户在政府采购网及第三方招标平台中搜索特定主题的招标公告和中标结果，并对搜索结果进行多维度分析，最终生成包含可视化图表的HTML分析报告。
 🔍 多渠道搜索：覆盖中国政府采购网（国家级+省级）、第三方招标平台（chinabidding、bidcenter等）
- 📊 趋势分析：时间趋势、地区分布、采购方式、预算规模四维度统计
- 🏢 中标企业分析：企业排名、市场集中度（HHI）、行业格局分析
- 💰 价格分析：中标价统计分布、折扣率、基准价计算
- 🎯 商机评估：5因素加权评分（市场体量、竞争程度、价格空间、进入门槛、地域开放）
skills.name: 招标搜索与中标分析
